caption: The drawing depicts a single metal kettle placed centrally within a faint square border on a plain, light beige background. The kettle is rendered in shades of brown and blue, with a textured, speckled surface on the main body suggesting a metallic or enamel finish. The spout is short and wide, angling upward to the left, while the handle is composed of a curved black metal wire topped with a wooden grip in a medium brown color. The lid is circular, slightly domed, and features a smaller, horizontal metal handle. At the top left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simple line sketch of a lidded jar or pot with a decorative swirl pattern. The artist’s name, "Vincent Rogel," and a numeric code are inscribed in small letters near the lower right corner inside the main square border.
title: Water Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
